json.justification: Photo 8 shows the meter on the brick wall of the low courtyard wing, between two ground-floor arched windows left of the glass entrance door, with open, level gravel in front. The wall in both directions (Photos 8, 9, 10) is a continuous row of ground-floor windows with brick piers about 2.5–3 ft wide, so any 3 ft tall battery would sit right under or against a possibly operable window, and the entrance door blocks the run to the right. The pier width, whether these windows open, and whether the open gravel courtyard is reachable by vehicles all need confirming by measurement or member input, not an auto-pass or reject.
